title: BumbleWarps
description: The best plugin for setting warps on your minecraft server.
body:
# BumbleWarps

The G.O.A.T plugin for your server warps with customizable messages, reload support, rename support and customizable teleport delay duration. 

Plugin By - .tgvampire

Plugin Commands

1. /setwarp
2. /delwarp
3. /renamewarp
4. /warp
5. /bwarps reload
